events.text: Ehrensvärd became acting sub-lieutenant (underlöjtnant) in the Swedish Navy.
events.subject: self
events.quote: He became acting sub-lieutenant ( underlöjtnant ) in the Swedish Navy in 1878

events.text: Ehrensvärd was promoted to lieutenant commander.
events.subject: self
events.quote: Ehrensvärd was promoted to lieutenant commander in 1900

events.text: Ehrensvärd became head of the Military Office of the Ministry for Naval Affairs.
events.subject: self
events.object: Military Office of the Ministry for Naval Affairs
events.quote: He was head of the Military Office of the Ministry for Naval Affairs from 1904 to 1906

events.text: Ehrensvärd's headship of the Military Office of the Ministry for Naval Affairs ended.
events.subject: self
events.object: Military Office of the Ministry for Naval Affairs

events.subject: self
events.quote: he was promoted to captain in 1905

events.text: Ehrensvärd was chief of the shipyard in Karlskrona.
events.subject: self
events.quote: Ehrensvärd was chief of the shipyard in Karlskrona in 1906

events.text: Ehrensvärd became Council of State (statsråd) and head of the Ministry for Naval Affairs.
events.subject: self
events.quote: Council of State ( statsråd ) and head of the Ministry for Naval Affairs from 4 December 1907

events.text: Ehrensvärd's post as Council of State and head of the Ministry for Naval Affairs ended.
events.subject: self
